findings.description: The KMS customer-managed key used for the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so the key material is never automatically rotated. CIS AWS Foundations requires rotation to be enabled for customer-created CMKs, limiting the blast radius of a compromised key.

No explicit policy is attached to the KMS key, so AWS applies the default key policy which delegates full control of the key to the account root and thereby to any IAM principal with sufficient IAM permissions. For a key protecting audit trail data, an explicit least-privilege key policy restricting kms:Decrypt/kms:Encrypt and kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion to specific principals should be defined.
